cleavage_agent.evidence: Two DLBCL cell lines, HT (GCB subtype) and TMD8 (ABC subtype), were used in all proteomics experiments. Biological triplicates of each cell line were treated with either DMSO or with 100 nM dasatinib for 30 min and 24 hr. Lysates were collected then incubated with multiplexed inhibitor beads (MIBs) to enrich for kinases, followed by trypsin digestion. All samples were analyzed by LC/MS/MS using a Thermo Easy nLC 1000-QExactive HF.
